newsitem.title: UK: British Aerospace wins $700 mln Hawk order.
newsitem.headline: British Aerospace wins $700 mln Hawk order.

text.p: British Aerospace said on Sunday that it had won an order worth 425 million pounds ($700.5 million) for more than 30 Hawk aircraft from Australia.
"The deal is worth 425 million pounds," a BAE spokeswoman told Reuters, adding that it was agreed after Australian Prime Minister John Howard visited its Warton factory in northern England.

"The British government is indeed proud, and extremely pleased, that the Commonwealth of Australia has selected the Hawk to meet the Royal Australian Air Force's lead-in fighter requirement," British Defence Minister George Robertson said in a statement.
British Aerospace was selected as the preferred candidate for the order last November.
The spokeswoman said the deal will be signed next week, "probably on Tuesday."
